cohort: Female patients and newborns at Phuentsholing General Hospital, including those who came to the Maternal and Child Health Unit (MCH), were admitted to the gynecology ward, and underwent obstetrical and gynecological surgeries.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic led to a decrease in maternal and child health care services, including admissions, deliveries, Cesarean sections, gynecological surgeries, follow-up visits, cervical cancer screenings, and immunization coverage.
mod_finding: The COVID-19 pandemic led to a decrease in the cesarean section rate.
